maintenance_rules: Do not add wiki claims without key-point evidence.
Do not add key points without raw-data evidence.
Prefer updating existing key points over duplicating concepts.
When evidence conflicts, preserve both claims and mark the conflict.
Selection rules should cite key-point IDs rather than raw papers directly.
Generated wiki prose is not primary evidence; raw_data and key_points are the evidence chain.
